purpose: Index of the doc-link design documents, stating the role of requirements versus design and mapping each design document to the content it owns.
summary: Requirements are the source of truth for behavior and constraints; design is for subjects, information, states, and processing
Design must not override requirements; unresolved items are not treated as confirmed specification
Table mapping DES-001 to DES-010 to their responsibilities
Diagrams are illustrative; the transition table in DES-004 is normative
Each process detail lives in one document and is not duplicated in the overall design
Requirements and designs are approved after review, and storage is decided as JSON files
tasks: Finding which design document covers a topic
Starting design work or review of doc-link
Resolving conflicts between requirements and design
Checking whether any decision is pending before implementing
title: doc-link 設計書の構成
